_comment: Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\AI Usage Native\config\settings.json. Every key is optional; leave one out for its default. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_localUtcOffsetHours: Hours from UTC that days are counted in. Default: this PC's current offset.
_maxIdleGapMinutes: A gap between transcript lines longer than this counts as time away, not runtime. Default: 30.
